# LReaParams 0.0.63
This release introduces major improvements to FX and Track parameter management, accessibility, keyboard navigation, parameter groups, memories, and legacy profile importing.
Based on the latest TEST62.9.2 development version.
### What's New
**FX Parameters and Groups** - Improved management of Custom Order and 12 independent parameter groups. - Each group preserves its own navigation grid and parameter positions. - Plugin Order always displays the original parameter list. - Improved copying, moving, and reordering of parameters between groups. - Global hidden parameters can be restored individually through FX Memories. - Improved parameter deletion and focus restoration. - Empty groups can be saved and recalled.
**FX and Track Memories** - Improved management of copied parameters, hidden parameters, and parameter steps. - Multiple memory entries can be selected and managed together. - New keyboard navigation options for selected memory entries. - Improved group identification and parameter occurrence tracking.
**Incremental Keyboard Search** - New incremental search across FX Parameters, Track Parameters, and memory managers. - Supports multiple characters, numbers, punctuation, and word prefixes. - Search resets after one second of inactivity. - Shift enables reverse searching. - Improved compatibility with Italian and European keyboard layouts.
**FX Chain Integration** - Press Alt+P in the native REAPER FX Chain list to open LReaParams FX Parameters for the highlighted plugin. - Existing REAPER keyboard shortcuts remain available outside this context.
**Legacy Profile Import** - New action: "LReaParams: Import selected legacy TXT files". - Import individual or multiple legacy Lua FX and Track parameter profiles. - Original TXT files are preserved. - Existing native profiles are protected against accidental overwriting.
**Documentation and Installation** - Updated accessible offline HTML guides in seven languages. - Updated About dialog and version information. - Updated Windows installer and GitHub Actions configuration. - Existing user profiles and settings are preserved.
### Installation
Download the Windows installer from the assets below.
Run the installer and select your REAPER resource directory. Portable REAPER installations are also supported.
After installation, restart REAPER.
LReaParams actions can be found in the REAPER Action List by searching for "LReaParams".
The extension also provides its own submenu under:
Extensions > LReaParams
### Accessibility
Designed for accessible keyboard-driven operation in REAPER, particularly with NVDA and OSARA.
The project focuses on giving users greater control over plugin parameters, navigation, organization, automation, and workflow accessibility.
### Source Code
The complete source code is available in this GitHub repository.
**Thank you for using LReaParams!**
Lo-lo
